plain: Slavery, or being under another's control.

webster.text: Slavery or involuntary servitude; captivity; imprisonment; restraint of a person's liberty by compulsion.

more.text: In scripture, spiritual subjection to sin and corrupt passions, or to the yoke of the ceremonial law; servile fear.

example.quote: We cannot endure the infamy and guilt of resigning succeeding generations to that wretchedness which inevitably awaits them, if we basely entail hereditary bondage upon them.
example.cite: Declaration of the Causes and Necessity of Taking Up Arms, July 6, 1775
